subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw accept chart widgets as a bundled modular-dashboard builtin now, and should that happen through the existing stacked PR or a narrower follow-up after the dashboard foundation lands?
rationale: The requested chart surface is a new user-facing bundled dashboard capability, depends on an unmerged dashboard foundation, and already has a linked implementation with product, compatibility, proof, and dependency-review questions automation cannot settle.

options.title: Repair and review the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101792 is fixed, restacked, proven in a live dashboard, and reviewed as the candidate implementation.

options.title: Defer until the dashboard base lands
options.body: Pause chart widgets until the Wave 1 dashboard stack is merged, then ask for a narrower chart-only PR without inherited stack risk.

options.title: Reject bundled charts for now
options.body: Close the roadmap item only if maintainers decide this chart surface should live outside the bundled dashboard or wait for a different product direction.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101792 is fixed, restacked, proven in a live dashboard, and reviewed as the candidate implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest current-main plugin-tab/Control UI seam and is the strongest routing candidate for whether this bundled dashboard surface belongs in OpenClaw now.
